title: Rewrite a water utility's LP in standard form

blocks.text: A water utility's analysts keep their LPs as plain data: a list of variable names, an objective (coefficients by name, and `"max"` or `"min"`) and a list of rows. Each row is a tuple `(coefficients, op, rhs)`: the coefficients by variable name (a variable missing from the dict has coefficient 0), `op` one of `"<="`, `">="` or `"=="`, and the right-hand side. Every variable is $`\ge 0`$. Their in-house LP code accepts only one shape, the standard form:
\max \; c^\top x \quad \text{s.t.} \quad A x \le b, \quad x \ge 0

Write `standard_form(variables, objective, sense, rows)` in `standard_form.py`. It returns `(c, A, b)` as plain lists: `c` has one entry per variable, in the order of `variables`; `A` is a list of rows, each a list with one entry per variable in that order; `b` has one entry per row of `A`. Rewrite with these moves:

rows: two rows, in this order: $`a`$ with $`r`$, then $`-a`$ with $`-r`$

blocks.text: Rows keep the order they were given in. About twelve lines; no solver needed.

from __future__ import annotations

Row = tuple[dict[str, float], str, float]       # (coefficients by variable, "<=" | ">=" | "==", right-hand side)


def standard_form(variables: list[str], objective: dict[str, float], sense: str, rows: list[Row]):
    """Rewrite an LP as max c.x s.t. A x <= b, x >= 0. Returns (c, A, b) as plain lists."""
    sign = 1.0 if sense == "max" else -1.0
    c = [sign * objective.get(v, 0.0) for v in variables]
    A, b = [], []
    for coefficients, op, rhs in rows:
        row = [coefficients.get(v, 0.0) for v in variables]
        if op in ("<=", "=="):
            A.append(row)
            b.append(rhs)
        if op in (">=", "=="):
            A.append([-a for a in row])
            b.append(-rhs)
    return c, A, b


if __name__ == "__main__":
    print(standard_form(["x", "y"], {"x": 1, "y": 3}, "min", [({"x": 2, "y": -1}, ">=", 6)]))

cases.says: a maximization with only <= rows is copied into c, A and b as it is
a >= row is multiplied by -1 on both sides, its right-hand side included
an equation becomes two rows: itself as <=, then its negation
a minimization becomes a maximization of the negated objective

origin.section: Every LP Can Be Rewritten Into One Standard Form

concepts: any LP is rewritten as a maximization with only <= rows and non-negative variables, without changing its solutions
